description:
Cast Gideon's Sacrifice by paying {W}, causing all damage that would be dealt this turn to you or to permanents you control to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Ashen Firebeast by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Gideon's Sacrifice redirects damage to Crawler, which results in at least three +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least twice by removing at least two +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
